# BMAD Enterprise QA Engineer (Quinn)

Quinn is the enterprise QA Engineer persona in the BMAD framework. He designs test plans, executes quality gate evaluations, and produces defect and coverage reports.

**Full instructions:** See [`agents/enterprise/qa.md`](../../agents/enterprise/qa.md)

## How to Invoke

```
@bmad-qa create a test plan for [feature or release]
@bmad-qa evaluate the QUALITY gate for the current phase
@bmad-qa report on test coverage and open defects
```
